title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Authentic Roman-style pasta using eggs, Pecorino/Parmesan, and pancetta. Based on BBC Good Food's classic approach (no cream).
cooking_steps: Step 1: Grate cheeses and cube pancetta; prep in 5 min.
Step 2: Boil 3 L water with salt; cook spaghetti 9 min until al dente.
Step 3: Melt butter and sauté pancetta with crushed garlic 5 min until browned.
Step 4: Whisk eggs with pecorino and parmesan 2 min.
Step 5: Reserve 150 ml pasta water; drain pasta 1 min.
Step 6: Toss pasta with pancetta off heat 1 min.
Step 7: Add egg-cheese mixture while tossing vigorously 2 min; loosen with pasta water as needed.
Step 8: Season with black pepper and adjust salt 1 min.
Step 9: Rest 2 min and serve immediately.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
description: Tandoori-style chicken pieces simmered in a buttery tomato-cream sauce. Based on IndianHealthyRecipes.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon, garlic, ginger, and spices 20 min.
Step 2: Sear marinated chicken in butter 8 min until lightly charred.
Step 3: Add tomato puree and simmer 10 min until thick.
Step 4: Stir in cream and sugar; simmer 5 min until silky.
Step 5: Adjust salt and garam masala; simmer 3 min.
Step 6: Rest 2 min and garnish with butter.
Step 7: Serve hot with rice or naan.

title: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind, fish sauce, palm sugar, eggs, tofu, and peanuts. Based on Serious Eats.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Soak rice noodles in warm water 20 min.
Step 2: Mix tamarind, fish sauce, palm sugar, and lime juice 2 min.
Step 3: Heat wok and add oil; sauté tofu 3 min.
Step 4: Push aside; scramble eggs 2 min.
Step 5: Add drained noodles and sauce; stir-fry 4 min.
Step 6: Toss in bean sprouts and garlic chives; stir-fry 2 min.
Step 7: Adjust seasoning; cook 1 min.
Step 8: Serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime wedges; rest 1 min.

title: Beef Bourguignon
description: Red wine–braised beef stew with carrots, onions, and herbs. Based on Serious Eats (Les Halles).
cooking_steps: Step 1: Pat beef dry and season; prep 5 min.
Step 2: Brown beef in oil 8 min until crust forms.
Step 3: Add onions and carrots; sauté 6 min.
Step 4: Stir in flour 2 min.
Step 5: Pour in red wine; simmer 5 min to reduce.
Step 6: Add stock and garlic; bring to a simmer 5 min.
Step 7: Cover and braise gently 90 min until tender.
Step 8: Uncover and reduce 10 min to thicken.
Step 9: Finish with parsley; rest 5 min before serving.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Pan-seared chicken glazed with soy, mirin, sake, and sugar. Based on Just One Cookbook.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Mix soy, mirin, sake, and sugar 2 min.
Step 2: Heat pan with oil; sear chicken 6 min skin-side.
Step 3: Flip and cook 5 min until nearly done.
Step 4: Add sauce; simmer and reduce 4 min to glaze.
Step 5: Rest 2 min; slice.
Step 6: Spoon glaze over and garnish with scallion 1 min.

title: Guacamole
description: Classic avocado dip with lime, onion, chili, and cilantro. Based on Simply Recipes.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Halve and mash avocados 3 min.
Step 2: Stir in lime juice and salt 1 min.
Step 3: Fold in onion, jalapeño, and cilantro 2 min.
Step 4: Add tomato and pepper; mix 1 min.
Step 5: Rest 5 min for flavors to meld.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Chunks of chicken in a spiced tomato cream sauce. Based on BBC Good Food.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Sauté onions in oil and butter 10 min.
Step 2: Add masala paste; cook 2 min until fragrant.
Step 3: Stir in tomatoes and tomato paste; simmer 10 min.
Step 4: Add chicken and peppers; simmer 12 min.
Step 5: Stir in chutney 2 min.
Step 6: Add cream and yogurt; simmer 5 min.
Step 7: Season and rest 3 min; garnish with cilantro.

title: Chicken Biryani
description: Layered basmati rice and spiced chicken cooked to a fragrant finish. Based on RecipeTin Eats.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Rinse and soak rice 20 min.
Step 2: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon, aromatics, and spices 30 min.
Step 3: Fry onions in ghee 8 min until golden.
Step 4: Parboil rice 5 min; drain.
Step 5: Layer chicken and onions; top with rice 3 min.
Step 6: Drizzle saffron milk; seal pot 1 min.
Step 7: Cook on low (dum) 25 min until steam builds.
Step 8: Rest 10 min; fluff and serve.

title: Pho Bo (Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup)
description: Aromatic beef broth with rice noodles, herbs, and thinly sliced beef. Based on Serious Eats.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Char onion and ginger 8 min.
Step 2: Blanch bones 5 min; rinse.
Step 3: Simmer bones with aromatics and water 90 min.
Step 4: Skim and season with fish sauce and rock sugar 5 min.
Step 5: Soak noodles 20 min; boil 1 min to finish.
Step 6: Arrange noodles and raw beef in bowls 3 min.
Step 7: Ladle boiling broth to cook beef 1 min.
Step 8: Garnish with scallion and cilantro; serve 1 min.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Sichuan stir-fry with chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, peanuts, and a sweet-sour-savory sauce. Informed by The Guardian's method.
cooking_steps: Step 1: Dice chicken and marinate with soy and cornstarch 10 min.
Step 2: Fry peanuts until crisp 3 min; remove.
Step 3: Heat oil; bloom chilies and Sichuan pepper 1 min.
Step 4: Stir-fry chicken 4 min until opaque.
Step 5: Add garlic, ginger, and scallion; stir-fry 2 min.
Step 6: Add soy, vinegar, sugar; toss 2 min.
Step 7: Return peanuts; stir 1 min to coat.
Step 8: Finish with sesame oil; rest 1 min.
